title: Character text got future-ready
summary: Version 3.3.0 introduced a centralized UI text system designed for future localization and character-aware voice overrides. It also included legal and update prompt improvements plus continued polish across Settings, onboarding, and content systems.
notes:
## Future-ready text foundation
Version 3.3.0 lays groundwork for a more adaptable CogniFocus experience by centralizing interface text and preparing the app for future localization support.

## What's improved
- Introduced a centralized UI text system to make future localization more manageable
- Prepared the app for character-aware voice and copy overrides in later updates
- Improved legal and update prompt clarity
- Continued polish work across Settings, onboarding, and content systems

## Overall result
This release is mostly foundational, but it makes future content updates, voice variations, and localization work much easier to ship cleanly.

title: A more adaptable app with clearer update communication
summary: Version 3.2.2 expanded accessibility support with reduced motion, enhanced contrast, and color-vision options. It also introduced the in-app What's New dialog system so product improvements can be surfaced more clearly after updates.
notes:
## Accessibility expanded
Version 3.2.2 makes CogniFocus more adaptable to different visual and motion needs while also improving how updates are communicated inside the app.

## What's improved
- Added reduced motion support
- Improved contrast handling for better readability
- Added color-vision support options
- Introduced the in-app What's New dialog system for post-update communication
- Made update messaging feel clearer and more intentional

## Overall result
This release improves accessibility and makes it easier for users to notice meaningful changes after installing a new build.

title: Protection holds up better when distractions hit
summary: Version 3.2.1 strengthened the native Shield path with better app-usage monitoring so distraction blocking stays more reliable in tougher cases. It also included accessibility and UI consistency improvements across multiple screens.
notes:
## Shield got tougher
Version 3.2.1 focused on making distraction blocking more dependable during real sessions, especially in edge cases where monitoring needed to be stronger.

## What's improved
- Improved native Shield behavior with better app-usage monitoring
- Increased distraction blocking reliability in tougher scenarios
- Added accessibility improvements across multiple screens
- Tightened UI consistency in several parts of the app

## Overall result
This update focuses on trust: Shield behaves more reliably when it matters, while the interface keeps getting cleaner and more consistent.

title: Daily objectives, feedback, sharing, and stronger session polish
summary: Version 3.2.0 was a bigger feature release. It added Daily Objective on Focus, lightweight post-session feedback, native app sharing, and the first future-companion teaser on intro screens. It also improved theme consistency, urgency visuals near session end, notification behavior, and Shield reliability.
notes:
## Focus expanded
Version 3.2.0 broadens the core focus experience with new lightweight features, more expressive session feedback, and stronger polish around active sessions.

## What's improved
- Added Daily Objective to the Focus experience
- Introduced lightweight post-session feedback
- Added native app sharing
- Included the first future-companion teaser on intro screens
- Improved theme consistency across the app
- Sharpened urgency visuals near session end
- Improved notification behavior and Shield reliability

## Overall result
This release makes active sessions feel more alive, more guided, and better supported before, during, and after focus time.

title: A clearer update path inside the app
summary: Version 3.1.3 introduced the in-app update prompt so users can see when a new build is ready and take action without guessing. It also laid groundwork for clearer release status handling in Settings.
notes:
## Update flow clarified
Version 3.1.3 makes updates easier to notice and understand from inside the app.

## What's improved
- Introduced the in-app update prompt
- Made it clearer when a new build is available
- Reduced guesswork around update availability and next steps
- Added groundwork for clearer release status handling in Settings

## Overall result
This release helps users understand when an update is ready and makes the upgrade path feel more direct.

title: Smoother surfaces and cleaner structure
summary: Version 3.1.2 tightened visual consistency across the app with cleaner component styling, improved spacing, and broader theme-token alignment. It was a polish pass focused on making the app feel more unified without changing the core flow.
notes:
## Visual consistency tightened
Version 3.1.2 is a polish-focused release that smooths out the app's presentation without changing how the core flow works.

## What's improved
- Cleaned up component styling across the app
- Improved spacing and structural consistency
- Broadened theme-token alignment for a more unified feel
- Reduced visual rough edges without changing core behavior

## Overall result
This release makes CogniFocus feel more cohesive and considered from screen to screen.

title: Sharpened
summary: Version 3.1.1 sharpens the app's first impression with a tighter onboarding flow, clearer Shield setup and status feedback, better light and dark theme support, and a more transparent in-app update experience.
notes:
## First impression, sharpened
Version 3.1.1 focuses on the first-run experience and the parts of Shield that need to feel immediately clear. Onboarding is tighter, Shield feels more alive and readable, and the update flow now communicates progress more clearly.

## What's improved
- Rebuilt onboarding into a tighter, more cinematic Goblin-led flow with cleaner copy and smoother motion
- Removed weaker onboarding steps so the flow lands faster and keeps the tension intact
- Improved Shield setup and Shield status pages with stronger copy, cleaner layouts, and less generic explanation text
- Added clearer live Shield states including Setup Required, Ready, Waiting for session, and Monitoring distractions
- Updated Shield overlay visuals and reason pills to work properly in both light and dark themes
- Improved the in-app update prompt with a real Starting update... state, dev debug info, and fallback feedback when the native handoff is not obvious
- Polished home and onboarding labels so the app feels less generic and more in-world

## Overall result
This release makes CogniFocus feel more polished from the first screen onward, while giving Shield better feedback, stronger presentation, and clearer status communication during real use.

title: Public changelog starts here
summary: This release is a big step forward for CogniFocus. We've redesigned the core app flow with a new Focus tab, refreshed onboarding, a smoother Focus Shield experience, new appearance settings including dark mode, and new timer clock styles.
notes:
## Big step forward
This release is a big step forward for CogniFocus. We've redesigned the core app flow with a new Focus tab, refreshed onboarding, a smoother Focus Shield experience, new appearance settings including dark mode, and new timer clock styles. The app now feels cleaner, faster, and more intentional across the full journey.

## What's included
- A redesigned core app flow centered around the new Focus tab
- Refreshed onboarding for a smoother first-run experience
- A more polished and intentional Focus Shield flow
- New appearance settings, including dark mode
- New timer clock styles for a more customizable focus experience

## Why this entry exists
This public changelog starts from the latest documented release state because earlier release notes were not being tracked on the website.

## Going forward
From this point on, new public-facing releases and notable improvements can be added here as separate changelog entries.

title: Landing page and policy pages refreshed
summary: The website was updated with better responsive behavior, a dedicated Terms of Use page, and a new What's New page for public release notes.
notes:
## What's improved
- The landing page navigation and button rows were adjusted to behave better on smaller screens
- Privacy Policy and Terms of Use now share a more consistent site shell and footer navigation
- A dedicated What's New page was added for public-facing release notes

## Overall result
The website experience feels more cohesive, more responsive, and better prepared to communicate ongoing product updates clearly.
